scope: Static installed Fast DDS XML/default-QoS parser proof; no DDS participant or simulator created.

primary_source_facts.fact: Load XML defaults first; localhost_only true appends both UDPv4 loopback and SHM descriptors afterward. ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=0 avoids this branch.
Load explicit FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE before testing SKIP_DEFAULT_XML; value 1 prevents later cwd default XML from overriding the default participant.
With RMW_FASTRTPS_USE_QOS_FROM_XML unset, RMW sets publication/memory defaults and DataSharing OFF, then applies ROS endpoint QoS.
With RMW_FASTRTPS_USE_QOS_FROM_XML unset, reader DataSharing is OFF; ROS endpoint QoS remains applied.
Publication sequence and publisher GID are assigned from DDS sample_identity and writer GUID independently of transport selection.
UDP user transport plus useBuiltinTransports=false is supported; non_blocking_send remains false to avoid silent full-buffer drops.
interfaceWhiteList restricts communication interfaces to the listed IPs.

limitations: This proves loaded native factory default transport configuration only; it does not create or test a live ROS graph.
RMW publication-sequence code remains transport independent, but full 18-topic live sequence support/continuity must pass the new complete frozen matrix.
Earlier Nav2 service response timeout cause remains undetermined. Disabling SHM is a declared infrastructure diagnostic, not proof of its cause or cure.
Old native results and failures remain unchanged and are not credited under this new environment.
